codeReview.summary: Implementation is clean and correct. generateWorkerContext() was extended with an optional basePath parameter to inject library content (pitfalls and conventions) into worker context. The function reads library topics via readLibraryTopic (which handles truncation and missing files), checks for header-only content via isHeaderOnly(), and injects non-empty content under 'Known Pitfalls' and 'Project Conventions' headings. Library content is placed between AGENTS.md content and completed features, correctly supplementing rather than replacing AGENTS.md. spawn-worker.ts was updated to pass deps.basePath. 12 comprehensive tests cover all expected behaviors including backward compatibility, missing library, truncation, and coexistence with completed features. All 2042 tests pass, typecheck clean, lint clean.

issues.description: The LIBRARY_TOPIC_HEADER_RE regex /^#\s+\w+\s*\n?$/ only matches single-word headers (e.g., '# Pitfalls'). Multi-word headers like '# Known Issues' would not be detected as header-only, causing unexpected injection of empty content. This is non-blocking because all default library topics use single-word headers, but it could surprise future maintainers adding custom topics with multi-word names.

sharedStateObservations.observation: The isHeaderOnly() function uses a regex that only matches single-word markdown headers after '#'. All current default topics (Architecture, Environment, Pitfalls, Conventions, Research) have single-word headers so this works, but the pattern could be fragile if custom topics with multi-word names are added later. Consider documenting this constraint or using a more permissive regex like /^#\s+.+\s*\n?$/.
